🌱 Morning Boost | Leaders · Monday

Notice one growth opportunity you've been sitting on for someone on your team.

Growth conversations often get postponed for more urgent, less important work.
Bring it up in your next 1:1, sketch out what a stretch assignment could look like, or simply ask what they want to grow into.
I will raise one growth opportunity with a team member today.
Affirmation: "Someone's growth is rarely urgent, but it's always important."

🧾 Morning Boost | Employers/HR · Tuesday

Simplify one piece of jargon-heavy communication today.

HR and legal language often protects the organization but leaves employees more confused than informed.
Rewrite one dense paragraph in plain language, add a summary at the top, or simply ask someone outside HR to read it first.
I will simplify one piece of jargon-heavy communication today.
Affirmation: "If people need a translator to understand your message, it isn't communication yet."

🔍 Midday Check-In | Employers/HR · Tuesday

Check whether a message you sent today could be read more than one way.

Tone is easy to lose in writing, and an ambiguous message leaves room for the reader to assume the worst.
Reread a recent message for tone, add a clarifying sentence if needed, or simply follow up with a quick call if it matters.
I will reread one message today for how it could be misread.
Affirmation: "If a message could be read two ways, someone will read it the harder way."
